concept: Terminal window with a bookmark: coding context saved for later sessions.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final standalone logo icon for Codex Mem, an open-source plugin that remembers project context between Codex coding sessions.
Create a completely new meaningful logo, not an abstract monogram. The entire mark is a compact dark charcoal terminal window with one bold amber bookmark ribbon attached over its upper-right edge. Inside the terminal, a large crisp ivory command prompt >_ is the only symbol. Terminal = coding, bookmark = saved context to return to next session. Make this relationship instantly obvious.
Style: beautifully proportioned flat 2D geometric software identity, strong minimal silhouette, crisp vector-like edges, controlled modest corner rounding. One terminal, one bookmark, one prompt. The bookmark has a clear swallowtail notch at its bottom, is integrated into the frame and does not look like a floating flag. Terminal frame subtle ivory edge so the mark works against light and dark backgrounds. Charcoal #20252B, ivory #F6F2E9, amber #F4B544. Large readable prompt, generous interior space, no tiny details. Square canvas, centered mark occupying about 76% of the canvas with balanced transparent margins.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the icon. No surrounding tile, no checkerboard. The terminal itself has a solid charcoal fill.
No wordmark or brand text. No brain, chip, network, cube, folder, C monogram, spiral, OpenAI knot, Claude star, gradients, lighting, bevel, 3D, drop shadow, texture, mockup, presentation board or extra variants. This must look like a finished original useful software icon.
cleanup_prompt: Edit the attached logo as a production cleanup. Keep the same terminal-window with amber bookmark and ivory >_ prompt concept and proportions. Remove ALL gradients, texture, lighting, and transparent holes. Terminal interior MUST be one continuous fully opaque flat solid charcoal #20252B region, including the empty space above the prompt. Bookmark MUST be one flat solid amber #F4B544 fill. Outline and >_ prompt flat ivory #F6F2E9. Put the entire icon on a fully opaque uniform white square background. No transparency anywhere in the final PNG. Crisp smooth antialiased contours, no speckles, no shadow, no 3D. Retain generous white margins around the centered icon. One single final icon, no mockup, no extra text.

validation.notes: Opaque white tile; charcoal terminal, ivory prompt, amber bookmark. Replaces the previous abstract C/archive mark.
